purpose: Sequential regression probes for transferring the investment learning loop without adding a universal workflow.

protocol.delivery: Fresh executor per sequence; send only the current turn after its predecessor finishes. Executors read the named skill snapshot, not this packet or grading criteria.
protocol.limits: Synthetic visible development probes, one run per sequence/arm, not held-out generalization or proof of improvement. Decision has a before/after pair; other skills have current-version checks.
protocol.tool_scope: Research, quant and decision: read snapshot, write only response/trace artifacts. Plan: isolated fixture only; preserve acceptance, source and previous evidence. No external calls, trading, production, commits or push.
protocol.telemetry: Preserve complete responses and artifacts; any executor action counts are self-reported. Unknown exact model identifier, tokens, billing and latency remain null.
protocol.acceptance: All criteria per sequence must pass. Any failure is retained, diagnosed, and separately retested; do not overwrite a miss. Do not edit runtime rules merely because an optional label is absent.

turns: 这是虚构的本地性能研究，不需联网。当前 M0: T(n)=2+0.1n 毫秒，声明适用 n=20..100；旧测量只有 n=20/40/60，误差容忍 ±0.1ms。只根据这些材料评价证据并给 n=80 的预测，保留模型和适用声明，供后续对账。无授权启动实验。
新一轮同版本环境、相同负载定义的重复测量：n=20/40/60 时分别为 5/7/9ms，各均值不确定区间 ±0.03ms；组件计时显示初始化现为3ms，逐项处理仍为0.1ms。请对账之前预测，说明现在更新什么、保留什么，并在结果出现之前预测 n=80。
后续独立批次：n=80 为19ms，n=100 为23ms，n=20/40 仍为5/7ms，误差均低于0.03ms。已确认请求 n>60 会走兼容路径，多耗0.1n ms；原路径未改。请对账之前声明和预测，解释当前模型边界，给尚未测试的 n=50/70 的预测及下一验证。有人建议把旧结论改写为‘只在 n<=60 有效，所以以前一直正确’，你怎么看？
criteria: R1: Preserves M0's stated 20..100 scope while distinguishes observed 20/40/60 from extrapolation; predicts 10ms at n80 conditional on M0.
R2: New measurements support changing intercept to3, not arbitrary new slope/mechanism; predicts11ms at n80 conditional; does not say unobserved n80 has passed.
R3: Settles 11ms forecast against19ms as a miss and rejects rescue of old broad claim by post-hoc narrowing.
R4: Proposes versioned path-conditioned relation (3+0.1n for <=60; 3+0.2n for >60), conditional predictions8/17 at50/70 with fresh verification, not already validated everywhere.

turns: 这是虚构的只读研究诊断，所需事实全在题目中；没有真实 bundle，不访问生产路径、不跑训练或数据诊断脚本。5个同身份交易日，旧/新候选的全tick IC中位数0.02/0.04，SIM成本后pot为0.3/0.6，REAL pot均0.1；模型候选身份有记录，但没有decision/order id和完整委托生命周期。问：IC改进没有兑现到实盘，现在能判断原因吗？下一步最值得补什么？

补充封存的配对研究结果：同一机会cohort、固定方向与t0价格归一基准、固定终点t0+100ms；稳定decision/order id覆盖委托、未成交、部分成交、撤单与拒单；两候选的目标、gate、成本、状态机相同，只有feature族不同。5日各日方向一致，无单日支配。旧/新从t0到终点的方向对齐mid markout均值为0.6/1.0bp；订单到场均为t0+80ms，从到场到同一终点剩余markout均为0.15bp。上述cohort保留未成交；实际成交子集另列，成本后增量为-0.02bp，日cluster区间[-0.05,0.01]；费用对账无差异。请更新上一轮解释，具体说哪条关系变了、哪些没证明、下一轮在什么阶段应看到什么。仍只分析，不启动实验。
没有新数据或新版本，今天只是原样重复上一条材料。需要重新改模型或者提出另一套归因吗？请给当前处置和再次更新的触发条件。
criteria: Q1: Aggregate gap remains unresolved; asks for identity/aligned decision/order lifecycle rather than declaring latency/slippage cause.
Q2: Paired evidence localizes incremental prediction markout before arrival in this cohort; distinguishes all-opportunity and filled subsets; no unsupported entire SIM/REAL causal decomposition.
Q3: Specific next stage-markout and net-increment prediction with fixed horizon/fresh evidence; no claim faster execution automatically improves net PnL or feature intrinsically useless.
Q4: No-new-evidence turn preserves judgment; no new parameter/regime story, no actual training/log/production writes.

criteria: D1: Preserves old4pp forecast; updates effect magnitude, not declares whole mechanism false or specific mediator proven.
